note: Named cut transitions for cut.json (per segment: "transition": "<name>", optional "transitionDur" in seconds, default 0.3). Each name maps to a stock ffmpeg xfade mode, so no gltransition build is needed. Any raw xfade mode name also works. An object ({"custom": "<id>"}) is a drawn transition from kit/xfx.cjs (an xfade custom expression; checkerboard takes the theme accent). The default (no "transition") stays the hard cut with the glitch seam. Name list adapted from ANVEAI/motion-pack transitions/lib/xfade.js (MIT); see THIRD_PARTY.md. "about" holds a one-line plain description of each name for npm run list and docs/effects.md.

about.glitch: hard cut with a quick shake and colour split on the seam (the default)
about.cut: plain hard cut, no blend and no shake
about.crossfade: the two shots blend smoothly into each other
about.dissolve: the new shot appears through a scatter of random pixels
about.film: fades through grey, like an old film cut
about.dip: dips to black, then fades up on the new shot
about.dip-black: dips to black, then fades up on the new shot
about.flash: flashes to white, then the new shot
about.dip-white: dips to white, then fades up on the new shot
about.whip: the new shot pushes the old one off to the left
about.whip-left: the new shot pushes the old one off to the left
about.whip-right: the new shot pushes the old one off to the right
about.push-left: the new shot pushes the old one off to the left
about.push-right: the new shot pushes the old one off to the right
about.swipe-up: the new shot pushes the old one up and out of frame
about.swipe-down: the new shot pushes the old one down and out of frame
about.cover-left: the new shot slides in over the old one, moving left
about.cover-right: the new shot slides in over the old one, moving right
about.cover-up: the new shot slides up over the old one
about.reveal-left: the old shot slides away to the left, revealing the new one under it
about.reveal-right: the old shot slides away to the right, revealing the new one under it
about.wipe: a hard edge wipes the new shot in, moving left
about.wipe-left: a hard edge wipes the new shot in, moving left
about.wipe-right: a hard edge wipes the new shot in, moving right
about.wipe-up: a hard edge wipes the new shot in, moving up
about.wipe-down: a hard edge wipes the new shot in, moving down
about.iris: a circle opens from the centre onto the new shot
about.iris-open: a circle opens from the centre onto the new shot
about.iris-close: the old shot shrinks away in a closing circle, the new one around it
about.circle-crop: the old shot closes to a circle on black, then the new shot opens out of it
about.doorway: the new shot opens out from a horizontal line across the middle
about.barn-door: the new shot opens out from a vertical line down the middle, like barn doors
about.zoom: zooms into the old shot as the new one fades in
about.zoom-through: zooms into the old shot as the new one fades in
about.pixelate: breaks into big pixels, then resolves on the new shot
about.blur: a horizontal smear blur carries one shot into the next
about.blur-cross: a horizontal smear blur carries one shot into the next
about.radial: a clock-hand sweep around the centre reveals the new shot
about.clock: a clock-hand sweep around the centre reveals the new shot
about.squeeze: the old shot squeezes flat to a line and the new one stretches out
about.slice: staggered horizontal slices sweep the new shot in
about.blinds: staggered horizontal slices sweep the new shot in, like blinds
about.wind: a streaky, wind-blown edge sweeps the new shot in
about.warp: a diagonal edge wipes across from one corner to the other
about.diagonal: a diagonal edge wipes across from one corner to the other
about.distance: the old shot melts into the new one by colour difference
about.slats: twelve vertical slats open one after another, left to right
about.checkerboard: a grid of tiles in the theme accent flips across on a diagonal
about.light-leak: a warm glow drifts across and blooms while the shots cross
about.zoom-blur: zooms into the old shot and out of the new one with a radial blur
about.news-ribbon: a red and white broadcast ribbon sweeps up across the frame
about.breaking-news: a red and white broadcast ribbon sweeps up across the frame
